It is an independent port of x138 ('nb953', LB 0.953, with the V1284 head). Message of d4cc70b, verbatim: 'nb953k (ILP division 0.4 + readmit 0.94) scored 0.956 and is the standard and package default ... Readmission direction closed: chained readmission (readmit_chain, nb953kc) 0.955, learned 16-feature logistic readmission scorer with a 3 % cap (readmit_scorer, nb953kl) 0.954; the Qwen text judge loses to distance alone. nb953kv15/kf/kcr6 packaged, unread'. Other LB reads: nb953z (16-view z-flip TTA 'd4z', gapfill off) = 0.949 (-0.004). The single-process nb953 run = 0.932 because it crossed REPAIR_DEADLINE_S 27000 s, which gives cheap post-processing on the tail volumes at about -0.03 per volume (-0.036/-0.032/-0.025). Sharded over 2 T4s (stems[i::n], 36000 s per shard) it scored 0.953. Their report says the +0.003 from DIV 0.4 and readmit 0.94 is 'not separable'. Arms with placeholder smoke only (no LB read), node deltas against nb953: nb953d below 0.1%; nb953r +0.3-0.5% (+2.9% on 44b6_0b24845f); nb953c +0.05/+2.2/+0.7/+0.6%; nb953r6 (readmit_radius_um 6.0) +0.04/+2.5/+0.1/+0.5%; nb953s4 (output_min_track_len 4) +0.8/+8.6/+2.1/+0.8%; nb953v15 (deepcenter_safe_div_threshold 0.25->0.15) about 0 nodes, forks x1.2-5; nb953f/kf (output_keep_ilp_divisions True) nodes about unchanged, forks x4-24. Also closed on their side: zero-shot Cellpose-SAM, intensity augmentation (-0.003), and a node-pruning post stage (negative on both judges). What it tells us: (a) the 743929 knobs transfer to x138 at +0.003, consistent with our exp85a 0.958 = exp70g 0.956 + knobs; (b) every readmission extension beyond 0.94 lost on the LB (-0.001 and -0.002); (c) it confirms our repair-deadline and safetail model, a -0.021 LB cost when the deadline fires on a single GPU.

findings.what: Honest answer: nothing reaches R8. AGGRESSIVE MODE treatment of every value Kai-Gowers disclosed, as a build on exp85a/exp87a, with its dummy gate, slot and expected value. (1) READMIT chain (readmit_chain True): LB-read by them at -0.001. E = -0.001 → no build. (2) Learned readmission scorer (logistic C=1, 16 features, cap 0.03): -0.002 on their LB. It also needs their .npz and a code port. E < 0 → no build. (3) readmit_radius_um 6.0: not read by them. It is in the I-183 family (refuted/deferred), and it adds nodes through the same channel as the chain (+2.5% on 44b6, similar to chain's +2.2%). The chain read -0.001, so E ≈ -0.001 → no build. (4) deepcenter_safe_div_threshold 0.15: not read. Our probes 43/44 at 0.20/0.225 both scored 0.954, below the K2 base (I-341/I-342), and 0.15 lies further in that refuted direction (forks x1.2-5). E < 0, and DeepCenter t* is on the closed list → no build. (5) output_keep_ilp_divisions True: forks x4-24 with no cap. This is the I-441 ILP-fork-restore family (refuted; its precision 0.149-0.19 is below the 0.161 break-even even with cap 6) → no build. (6) output_min_track_len 4: our probe 6 went 0.944 -> 0.943, and it adds +8.6% nodes on one volume → closed. (7) z-flip TTA: I-150 refuted (probes 12/16), and now 0.949 externally → closed. (8) 2-GPU sharding with a 36000 s per-shard deadline: runtime-headroom family, closed. It only confirms what the GAP RULE and safetail already cover. Runtime cost is irrelevant because nothing is built. No build has a free slot anyway: the remaining 29 Sep slots belong to MORNING TABLE v1.1. The finals plan {V_pub, #37 or exp75} gets no new input: the external data supports DIV 0.4 + READMIT 0.94 in V_pub and adds no evidence for or against CI or K for private.
